import csv
occ_id = "fb91b6fa-b336-5d94-a6fe-e00343bc30a9"
pow_id = "1b318110-05c1-54b3-8fea-315f5900b64a"

by_id = {"occ": {}, "pow": {}}
with open(VALUES_CSV) as f:
    for row in csv.DictReader(f):
        ts = row['timeseries_id']
        if ts in (occ_id, pow_id):
            d = "occ" if ts == occ_id else "pow"
            ts_key = row['timestamp']
            try:
                by_id[d][ts_key] = float(row['value'])
            except:
                pass

# restrict to 2018-07-23
day = "2018-07-23"
occ = {k:v for k,v in by_id["occ"].items() if k.startswith(day)}
powv = {k:v for k,v in by_id["pow"].items() if k.startswith(day)}
print("occ count on day:", len(occ))
print("pow count on day:", len(powv))
common = set(occ) & set(powv)
print("common:", len(common), sorted(common)[:5])

# condition: pow > 1 and occ == 0
count = 0
detail = []
for k in sorted(common):
    if powv[k] > 1 and occ[k] == 0:
        count += 1
        detail.append((k, powv[k], occ[k]))
print("COUNT:", count)
print(detail[:10])
# sample of values
print("sample occ values:", sorted(set(occ.values()))[:10])
print("sample pow values:", sorted(set(powv.values()))[:10])
